edits.old_line: The entire .repo folder currently has the entire data and history. Everything that is not temporary MUST be moved outside of the repo folder. It MUST live in a postgres database on the server (schema under repo/postegres/schema.sql). The server is additionally a discord bot that send messages to different channels on the community discord server. All events trigger a message to the discord server.
